title: MQTT CONNECT with username/password in clear text
advice: Use MQTT over TLS (8883) with per-client credentials or certificates.

title: SNMP v1 with default community 'public'
advice: Move to SNMPv3 (authPriv) and remove default community strings.

title: Telnet management (clear-text credentials)
advice: Disable Telnet; use SSH for device management.

title: IEC 104 control command
example: I-frame C_SC_NA_1 single command, COT 6, CA 1
advice: Permit commands only from the controlling station's IP; IEC 62351-3 (TLS) protects 104 on untrusted links.

title: Modbus write operation
advice: Modbus has no authentication. Restrict which hosts may write with an industrial firewall / DPI rule (allow-list function codes per source) and log every write.

title: EtherNet/IP ListIdentity (device discovery)
advice: Device discovery is normal from engineering tools; alert when it comes from an unexpected host.
